decisions.reason: The transactional email service is featured on the home page and builds on core messaging infrastructure, so its carrying cost is low and its upside in cloud messaging is still uncertain but promising.
Document capture has a dedicated page and fits the firm's electronic document workflow strategy, so it is worth keeping while demand resolves, though it lies further from core messaging.
Email-to-fax conversion reuses the existing fax and email platforms at little marginal cost and serves regulated customers who still depend on fax.
This low-cost feature close to the established fax offer adds value to the existing service, even though fax as a whole is declining in the long run.
Sandbox threat protection addresses growing security demand and complements the firm's secure messaging positioning, so the option remains valuable.
Multi-engine virus scanning is an inexpensive extension of the existing email security service and supports its reliability and compliance promise.
